products.description: The ICX 8100-24P is an entry-level RUCKUS access switch with 24 1GbE RJ45 PoE/PoE+ ports, four uplink ports supporting 1G SFP or 10G SFP+ optics, a 370 W PoE budget and 132 Gb/s switching capacity. products.keywords: ruckus icx 8100-24p poe+ switch 10g sfp+ small business

products.name: Dell PowerSwitch S5232F-ON 100GbE Switch
products.summary: 1RU 32-port 100GbE multi-rate spine/leaf open-networking switch with full L2/L3 switching and routing.
products.description: The PowerSwitch S5232F-ON is a 1RU, 32-port 100GbE multi-rate spine/leaf switch in Dell's S5200-ON family. Dell lists full Layer 2/Layer 3 switching and routing, QoS, multicast, a 4.8 Bpps forwarding rate and open-networking (ONIE) support for SmartFabric OS10 or other network operating systems.
products.keywords: dell powerswitch s5232f-on 100gbe qsfp28 spine leaf open networking

products.name: Cisco Meraki MX68 Security & SD-WAN Appliance
products.summary: Desktop security/SD-WAN appliance for up to 50 users with 2x GbE WAN, 10x GbE LAN (two PoE+) and 700 Mbps firewall throughput.

products.keywords: cisco meraki mx68 sd-wan firewall poe+ small branch

products.name: Cisco Meraki MX105 Security & SD-WAN Appliance
products.summary: Rack-mount SD-WAN security appliance for up to 750 users with 10G SFP+ and 2.5G WAN ports and 3 Gbps firewall throughput.
products.description: The Meraki MX105 is a large-branch security and SD-WAN appliance. Cisco lists two 10 GbE SFP+ and two 2.5 GbE RJ45 WAN ports (one PoE), four GbE RJ45 and two 10 GbE SFP+ LAN ports, 3 Gbps firewall and 1 Gbps site-to-site VPN throughput, for up to 750 users.

products.summary: Campus/data-center SD-WAN security appliance for up to 2,000 users with 10G SFP+ WAN and 4 Gbps firewall throughput.
products.description: The Meraki MX250 is aimed at large branches, campuses and data centers. Cisco lists two 10 GbE SFP+ WAN ports and eight GbE RJ45, eight GbE SFP and eight 10 GbE SFP+ LAN ports, with 4 Gbps firewall and 1 Gbps site-to-site VPN throughput, for up to 2,000 users.

products.name: Cisco Meraki MS130-12X Multigigabit PoE+ Switch
products.summary: Compact cloud-managed mGig switch with 8x GbE + 4x 2.5GbE PoE+ ports (240 W) and 2x 10G SFP+ uplinks.
products.description: The Meraki MS130-12X is a cost-effective multigigabit switch for Wi-Fi 6/6E branch deployments. It has eight GbE ports and four 2.5 GbE mGig ports with a 240 W PoE+ budget, two 10 GbE SFP+ uplinks, and is hardware-ready for Adaptive Policy.
products.keywords: cisco meraki ms130-12x mgig 2.5g poe+ compact switch

products.name: Palo Alto Networks PA-7500 Chassis Next-Generation Firewall
products.summary: Nine-slot chassis NGFW scaling to 1.5 Tbps firewall (appmix) and 1.44 Tbps threat prevention, with 400G QSFP-DD ports on each network card.
products.description: The PA-7500 is Palo Alto Networks' flagship chassis firewall for service-provider cores, hyperscale data centers and AI data center interconnect. Its nine slots take network, data and management processing cards; each network processing card provides eight 400/100/40G QSFP-DD and twelve 100/25/10G SFP-DD ports. A fully loaded system is rated at 1,500 Gbps firewall and 1,440 Gbps threat prevention throughput (appmix), with each data processing card adding 310 Gbps firewall throughput.
products.keywords: palo alto pa-7500 chassis ngfw 400g qsfp-dd data center service provider

products.name: Cisco Nexus 93108TC-FX3P Multigigabit PoE Switch

products.keywords: cisco nexus 93108tc-fx3p multigig poe 10gbase-t data center switch

products.name: Cisco C9350-48HXN Smart Switch
products.summary: Campus smart switch with 36x 5G and 12x 10G multigigabit UPOE+ (90 W) ports, uplinks up to 200G and 1 Tbps switching capacity.

products.summary: Stackable 24-port multigigabit switch with 12x 2.5GbE and 12x 10GbE 90 W PoE ports, 100GbE uplinks and 700 Gb/s switching capacity.

products.name: RUCKUS R550 Wi-Fi 6 Indoor Access Point
products.summary: Mid-range dual-band Wi-Fi 6 AP with 2x2:2 radios, up to 1,774 Mbps, BeamFlex+ antennas, embedded IoT and two GbE ports.
products.description: The RUCKUS R550 is a mid-range dual-band, dual-concurrent Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) access point with four spatial streams (2x2:2 on 2.4 and 5 GHz), peak data rates up to 1,774 Mbps and up to 512 client connections. products.name: SonicWall NSa 4800 Gen 8 Next-Generation Firewall
products.summary: 1U Gen 8 NGFW with 24x 1GbE and 8x 10G SFP+ ports, 20 Gbps firewall and 13 Gbps threat prevention throughput.
products.description: The NSa 4800 is a Gen 8 SonicWall mid-range firewall running SonicOS 8, with twenty-four 1GbE ports, eight 10/5/2.5/1G SFP/SFP+ ports and 256 GB storage (expandable to 1 TB). products.keywords: sonicwall nsa 4800 gen 8 ngfw 10g rack firewall

products.name: Extreme Networks AP5010 Wi-Fi 6E Access Point
products.summary: Tri-radio Wi-Fi 6E indoor AP with three 4x4:4 radios (up to 10 Gbps aggregate), a 5GbE PoE uplink and a 2.5GbE port.
products.description: The AP5010 is an Extreme Universal, world-SKU Wi-Fi 6E access point for high-density venues. Three 4x4:4 radios on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz deliver up to 10 Gbps aggregate 802.11ax data rates, and it has a 100M-5G Ethernet port (PoE in) and a 100M-2.5G port that can supply 15.4 W PoE out when powered by 802.3bt.
products.keywords: extreme networks ap5010 wifi 6e 4x4 universal access point
